flow: 1 Plan (2 min): one note box per cue-card point; model hidden

5 Try again up to three times; compare each checked try with the one before it

focusQuestion.question: What helped the speaker feel at home in the new city?
focusQuestion.feedback: She joined a running group and made friends there.

modelParts.text: When I moved to a new city last year, I didn't know anyone.
In my old town, I used to see my friends every weekend, and we would often cook together on Sunday evenings.
So the biggest challenge I faced was meeting people outside work.
It took me a few weeks to get used to spending my evenings alone.
One evening, while I was walking home, I saw a poster for a running group.

modelParts.purpose: Shows how the speaker made friends.
modelParts.text: I'd never run with a group before, so I was nervous at the first session, but I gradually got to know the other runners.
Since then, I've made a few friends, and the city feels more like home.
I've been running with the group for about six months now.
When I look back on those first few weeks, I'm really glad I went to that first session.

modelParts.text: My goal is to start a career in design.
I intend to take a short course this spring, and I'm meeting someone from the college on Thursday.

modelParts.purpose: Adds something to look forward to.
modelParts.text: I'm looking forward to seeing some of the students' work.
A friend who did the course has offered to help me choose a project.

modelParts.purpose: Adds an opinion about the goal.
modelParts.text: I think it'll be hard work, but it'll be worth it.
When I finish the course, I'll apply for a few junior roles and use my project to show what I can do.
If I don't get a place this spring, I'll take an evening class instead.
And if I had more free time, I'd study full-time, but I need to keep working for now.

You don't have to cook for everyone, but we usually eat together on Fridays.

modelParts.text: If you visit this town, start at the market hall.

modelParts.purpose: Gives a past fact and a regular event.
modelParts.text: It was built in 1890, and the food market is held there every Saturday.
It's a local tradition, and you can try food from nearby farms.
It's the busiest place in town on a Saturday morning, so I'd set off early.
There's also a local custom that surprises visitors: most shops are closed on Wednesday afternoons, so plan your shopping for another day.
Afterwards, take a walk by the river.
It's quieter than the centre, and it's the spot where I go to relax.
The town isn't a famous destination, but it's one of the friendliest places I know.
